concept.description: Labels in-memory POI workbook constructors (XSSF / HSSF) as :HeavyWork.
concept.cypher: MATCH (lt:Type)-[:DECLARES]->(m:Method) WHERE coalesce(m.name, last(split(split(m.signature, '(')[0], ' '))) = '<init>' AND lt.fqn IN ['org.apache.poi.xssf.usermodel.XSSFWorkbook', 'org.apache.poi.hssf.usermodel.HSSFWorkbook'] SET m:HeavyWork:InMemoryWorkbook RETURN count(DISTINCT m) AS Constructors

constraint.description: XSSFWorkbook / HSSFWorkbook hold the whole workbook in memory: use SXSSFWorkbook (streaming) for exports.
constraint.cypher: MATCH (t:Type)-[:DECLARES]->(m:Method)-[:INVOKES]->(c:Method:InMemoryWorkbook) WHERE NOT t:Test RETURN DISTINCT m AS Element, t.fqn AS Fqn, c.signature AS Detail
